rows.probe_evidence: Script: index grep 'current through the last amended date'; 33v03.docx now extracts 1,976,234 chars
rows.instruction_problems: Record says the .docx is unreadable (shell http-error, text link-only). With .docx support the script route works: `links <index> .docx` (157 links, text 'Title 33:III, Environmental Quality: Air'); `verify` exact 'The provisions of this Chapter apply to the owner and operator' PASSED at offset 197063. Traps: (1) whole-part files have a table of contents first, so grep '§501\. Scope' hits the TOC (offset 1459) before the body (offset 197015); (2) the file never contains 'LAC 33:III.501' — sections are headed '§{section}. {catchline}' inside the part file; (3) pages=1 (no page numbers); (4) titles split into parts/volumes (33v03, 46v01, 01v01-03) so map title:part -> link text 'Title {t}:{Roman part}' not file name.
rows.suggested_fix: Upgrade: read_via script; text fetch-and-quote; shell ok; navigation 'index -> link text "Title {t}:{part}" (or "Title {t}," for unsplit titles) -> .docx -> fetch_doc.py grep "§{section}\. " and take the match after the TOC (or section --start "§{section}\. " past the TOC)'. Currency: index 'Last Amended Date' plus file last-modified (33v03: 28 Apr 2026). Make it the tier-1 route ahead of la-lac-lii.
